name: Broken Sky
source:
You lived your whole life around this place and you really like it. But now you have to leave. It's time to say goodbye...

[From: [url=http://lunaen.com/]denzil's homepage[/url]]
translation:
你從小就住在這裡，也非常喜歡這裡。可如今，你不得不離開。是時候道別了……

[摘自[url=http://lunaen.com/]denzil的首頁[/url]]
